## Action
The core room. Elena has invited them all here. This is the moment the secret ends.

## Gap
She expects anger. Instead, the children — the ones who've already accessed partial truth — look at her with something more complicated than forgiveness: understanding.

## Choice
She tells everything. No justification, no framing. Just the math and the choice and the cost.

## Shift
The value doesn't return to positive. She's not redeemed. But there's an ironic resolution — the truth is both lighter and heavier than the secret.
